In which month was the production of all types of bikes the lowest?
solution:
**Calculation**

The production of all types of bikes in July = 58 + 89 + 54 + 72 = 273

The production of all types of bikes in August = 38 + 46 + 64 + 53 = 201

The production of all types of bikes in September = 56 + 45 + 76 + 65 = 242

The production of all types of bikes in October = 15 + 26 + 80 + 37 = 158

The production of all types of bikes in November = 45 + 36 + 54 + 21 = 156

The production of all types of bikes in December = 33 + 40 + 41 + 44 = 158

**We can clearly conclude the production was lowest in November.**
